reference: Thin SVD of A, spectrum of sigma^2 I + 4 A A^T; orthogonal residual quadratic
interpretation: This follows up, rather than erases, the Cholesky diagnostic failure at the same1e-7 evidence threshold. The SVD formula avoids a dense ill-conditioned covariance factorization and cancellation in inverse-based quadratics. Shared frozen design matrices remain an explicit limitation of the independent reference.
